planned_repositories.name: SAGE-Mail-Intelligence
planned_repositories.description: Email intelligence for the SAGE ecosystem: Gmail analysis, project monitoring, summaries, and approval-gated drafts.
planned_repositories.readme:
# SAGE-Mail-Intelligence

A dedicated email-intelligence project in the SAGE ecosystem.

## Initial scope
- Read-only Gmail search and retrieval
- Project email classification and monitoring
- Thread summaries and action-item extraction
- Draft generation for human review
- Sending remains an explicit, separately approved action

## Security
- Keep credentials and tokens out of Git
- Use least-privilege permissions
- Do not auto-send messages
- Maintain audit trails for external actions

## Status
Planned project; integration with S.A.G.E will be tracked here.

planned_repositories.readme:
# SAGE-EventKit

A premium web application for creating useful event materials and managing event workflows.

## Product direction
- Individuals and business customers
- Premium templates and reusable event deliverables
- One-time purchase for buyers, not a buyer subscription
- Secure purchase verification and license activation

## Planned work
- Requirements and user journeys
- Data model and access rules
- Payment verification and activation
- Export and delivery workflows
- Launch and support documentation

## Status
Product strategy and implementation specification stage.

planned_repositories.name: SAGE-Lead-Gen-Studio
planned_repositories.description: Standalone lead-generation products and business tools designed for useful delivery and one-time sales.
planned_repositories.readme:
# SAGE-Lead-Gen-Studio

A collection of focused lead-generation software products for small businesses and service providers.

## Product principles
- Solve a concrete customer-acquisition problem
- Use transparent, authorized data sources
- Avoid spam, deceptive scraping, and unauthorized access
- Prefer useful exports, qualification workflows, and customer-managed outreach
- Evaluate one-time purchase delivery where suitable

## Status
Concept and product discovery. Define each product before implementation.

planned_repositories.name: SAGE-Leveling-to-the-West
planned_repositories.description: Gamified martial arts and fitness progression app with skill paths, training logs, mobility, conditioning, and recovery tracking.
planned_repositories.readme:
# SAGE-Leveling-to-the-West

A gamified training and personal-development application centered on martial arts fundamentals, movement skills, and sustainable progress.

## Planned areas
- Skill paths and training progression
- Session logging and achievement systems
- Martial arts fundamentals and technique study
- Strength, conditioning, mobility, and recovery tracking
- Adaptable training levels and safety guidance
- Animated feedback and progression visualizations

## Design principle
Reward consistency, skill quality, recovery, and safe progression rather than extreme training volume.

## Status
Concept and product planning.

planned_repositories.name: NOMSHU-DO
planned_repositories.description: Martial arts learning framework and personal training curriculum documenting fundamentals, principles, progression, and safe practice.
planned_repositories.readme:
# NOMSHU-DO

A martial arts learning framework and personal training curriculum.

## Planned documentation
- Training philosophy and principles
- Fundamental movement and coordination
- Mobility, conditioning, and recovery
- Technical learning pathways
- Skill assessment and progression criteria
- Safe practice boundaries and qualified instruction requirements

## Relationship to SAGE Leveling to the West
NOMSHU-DO documents the training framework. SAGE Leveling to the West is the planned software experience that may present and track parts of that framework.

Concept documentation.

planned_repositories.name: BLAZEFORCE-Training-System
planned_repositories.description: Safe conditioning and athletic-development concept focused on fitness tracking, controlled progression, and recovery.
planned_repositories.readme:
# BLAZEFORCE-Training-System

A training-concept project for documenting athletic development, conditioning, and sustainable performance.

## Planned areas
- Strength and general conditioning
- Speed, coordination, and agility development
- Mobility and flexibility work
- Recovery and workload tracking
- Clear intensity scaling and rest guidance

## Safety principle
No overheating, dehydration, or extreme exertion targets. Progress is measured through consistent, appropriately scaled training and recovery.

## Status
Concept and research.

planned_repositories.name: Altair-AC-Modding-Lab
planned_repositories.description: Research and tooling for modding the original Assassin's Creed game through available modding interfaces and a custom workflow.
planned_repositories.readme:
# Altair-AC-Modding-Lab

A fan modding research and tooling project focused on extending the original Assassin's Creed experience using available modding interfaces and workflows.

## Planned areas
- File and asset-format research
- Mod packaging and compatibility tooling
- Configuration and runtime-behavior documentation
- Engine-aware mod development workflow
- Testing and versioned mod releases

## Project boundaries
This is a modding project, not a claim to own or recreate Ubisoft technology. Do not commit proprietary game binaries or assets. Store original tools, documentation, and user-created work here.

## Status
Research and tooling design.
